desc:
Please like us 👍 and join the community to learn about updates! ⭐

⭐ Welcome to My Pet City! A vibrant world to hang out, roleplay, and explore! 🌴✨

🐱 Be a Pet or roam free as a Stray!
🦄 Explore to find exotic and wild pets
🏡 Choose your dream home and make it your own!
🚕 Drive stylish cars that match your vibe!
🗞️ Get a Job as a Bobarista, Firefighter, and more!
🦋 Chat and make friends with other players!

Enjoying the game? Support us with a thumbs-up 👍 and favorite ⭐!
